unchanged: all 90 frozen R4 cells and results

Complete all-fifty-source head/full chat-template window audit on three serving tokenizers

Audit whether CODE_PREFIX metadata fields affect current decisions; do not change unused fields to claim a speed repair

input_packing.optional_context_rule: Deterministic original head/tail paragraph or line units with explicit omission marker; original retained whitespace preserved, no split-and-space rejoin
input_packing.final_fit: Every declared tenant/turn/model raw and selected candidate complete chat template plus unchanged family output budget must fit the actual 16384 window
input_packing.critical_overflow: Report unsupported input without cutting CODE_PREFIX/query or substituting a favorable source after model outcomes
input_packing.shared_task_content: Raw and ContractKV receive the same packed task text; only the existing legal CALC layout differs
input_packing.online_generation_protocol: stable_word_limit=0 on already packed faithful sources, preventing a second whitespace-destroying pass

known_source_development.sources: The first two HotpotQA and first two RepoBench sources from the original frozen R4 fan-out subset
known_source_development.contract_local_repair: If task-definition and known-source diagnostics establish that independent-statement parsing is inapplicable to the declared next-line fragment contract, evaluate one fixed operator-declared fragment variant on faithful input. Keep behavioral margins/scope/PSTP; do not optimize the rule using score improvements.
known_source_development.comparison: Any fragment variant receives its own fresh raw/risk paired cells. Preserve the input-only unchanged-rule arm to avoid attributing a contract change to input fidelity.
known_source_development.interpretation: Previously observed development sources, single fresh repeat; no independent-validation or process-uncertainty claim

independent_validation.exclusions: All pre-R4 committed exclusion cohorts, all 50 R4 sources, and recovered original task-bearing and marker service sources
independent_validation.selection: Hash order within family; common-engine critical-field capacity eligibility only. Pack optional context by the fixed rule; record all capacity-ineligible candidates. Never filter by gold location, raw accuracy, output stability, qualification or speed.
independent_validation.admission_version: Select only from the input-only original R4 rule and at most one necessary task-contract compatibility repair, using known-source development before freezing these new sources; no margin/cost refitting
independent_validation.fixed_L0_families: Inherited R4 Mistral/Llama RepoBench L0 remains L0; do not enlarge its calibrated family qualification to force non-RULER coverage
independent_validation.GPU_assignment: Counterbalanced model-repeat paired blocks across two lanes; same lane within each raw/risk pair
independent_validation.source_uncertainty: Three independent source clusters per family and three fresh processes; retain wide descriptive intervals and do not claim population coverage or universal p99 improvement

clock_and_cost: Closed-loop two-request readiness waves; all actual business/controller/candidate preparation/qualification and waits charged in service wall. Offline immutable input trace packing and tokenizer-only audits are separately reported CPU work shared by raw and ContractKV, not hidden GPU savings.
Table_I_repair_evidence: Do not invent provenance for old 85/2.4 literals. Record real application template ordering separately from prevalence; measure reproducible stable-input spans and native APC counters on the new faithful workload using the same actual serving logs.
report_all: cache objects and zero rejected publication
raw repeated-run variability and length stops
input omissions/critical preservation and CPU preparation provenance
dispatch_dependency: No new GPU request until the existing complete frozen R4 matrix has finished and its workers exited. Every new development/validation protocol must be source/input frozen and publicly archived with remote SHA verification before its first forward.
finite_scope: One known-source Qwen four-grid plus at most one necessary contract compatibility pair, then one independent eighteen-cell validation. No additional workload, model, tail optimization, threshold search, source replacement or new certificate architecture in response to those outcomes.
deliverables: After audits and scientific stop decision, deliver the two requested experiment-only reports. Manuscript and final response-letter text integration remain deferred. Preserve unfavorable and unresolved outcomes explicitly.
